name: research-public-web
job: Research the public web without paid SERP keys; cite sources and record adapter gaps.

inScope: Framing the decision the research must support
Searching with free no-key paths first
Fetching primary sources with URL and retrieved time
Synthesizing answer-first with citations and unknowns
outOfScope: Deep browser automation for authenticated app flows

inputs: Research question and the decision it supports
Must-have sources: official docs, registry, standards
outputs: Source list with URLs and excerpts
Free-path versus paid-path labels and gaps

tools: host web tools or no-key search adapters

failureSemantics: Blocked hosts, stale pages, and thin evidence are recorded as gaps, never silent skips; unpaid scraping is never laundered into API-backed certainty; site ToS and rate limits are respected.

outcome.observable: A decision-ready answer (or explicit blocked) with cited sources, retrieved times, labeled free versus paid paths, and an honest gap list an independent researcher can re-fetch.
